page.overview:
Who is Wanda?

Wanda is a canine mink of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, previously also acting as a Kingsbird to both Inuarashi and Nekomamushi.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Zou and Wano Country Arcs.

Wanda is a tan-furred, orange-haired, curvaceous and well-endowed canine mink with a large bushy tail.

When first meeting Luffy's group, Wanda wore Nami's blue jeans, black high-heeled boots, and green-white striped bikini top after Nami lent them to her. Wanda also wears the Musketeer's blue cape and another blue cloth tied around her jeans.
